content_sections.heading: About Namakkal District Health Society
content_sections.text: District Health Society is the district-level health body at Namakkal, with its office in the District Collector's office campus. The notice says the posts are newly created under the National Health programme or vacant under various schemes in Namakkal district. The notice is signed by the District Health Officer / Executive Secretary and the District Collector / Chairman of the Society.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 28 vacancies across seven posts. It does not print category-wise (reservation) figures or department names.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Namakkal District Health Society Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Collect the application form from the Namakkal District Health Office in person, or download it from namakkal.nic.in. Fill in the form and attach self-attested copies of all certificates relevant to the post. Submit the application in person or send it by Speed Post to: District Health Officer / Executive Secretary, District Health Society, Collectorate Campus, Namakkal District - 637003. Make sure the application reaches the office by 5.00 PM on 30 November 2026; applications received after that time will not be accepted. The office telephone number printed in the notice is 04286-281424.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Evidence of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC Certificate) Evidence of Educational Qualification and Marks (10th, 11th, 12th, Diploma, Degree, Provisional and Course Certificate etc.) Proof of Residency: Voter ID / Aadhar Card / Ration Card / Phone Bill / EB Bill Any other special records of significance from competent authorities as indicated in the selection criteria All certificate copies must be self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: All seven posts are wholly temporary and on contract basis. No post will be made permanent at any time. Applications received after 5.00 PM on 30 November 2026 will not be accepted. Applications are accepted in person or by Speed Post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Namakkal District Health Society recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 28 vacancies across seven posts: 2 Ayush Medical Officer (Siddha), 3 AYUSH Pharmacist, 3 Multi Purpose Worker, 1 Therapeutic Assistant, 1 Therapeutic Assistant (Female), 17 Nursing Therapist / Therapeutic Assistant and 1 UHWC – Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office by 5.00 PM on 30 November 2026. Applications received after that time will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Ayush Medical Officer (Siddha)?
faq.answer: The qualification is Bachelor of Siddha Medicine and Surgery. The age limit is 59 years as on 31.10.2026 and the salary is Rs.40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: It is 59 years for six posts (31.10.2026 is printed for five of them), and less than 40 years as on 31.10.2026 for UHWC – Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Pay per month is Rs.40,000 (Ayush Medical Officer, Siddha), Rs.18,000 (AYUSH Pharmacist), Rs.11,000 (Multi Purpose Worker), Rs.15,000/- (Therapeutic Assistant), Rs.17,000/- (Therapeutic Assistant, Female), Rs.13,000/- (Nursing Therapist / Therapeutic Assistant) and Rs.63,000 (UHWC – Medical Officer).

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application form in person or by Speed Post to the District Health Officer / Executive Secretary, District Health Society, Collectorate Campus, Namakkal District - 637003, with self-attested copies of certificates.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The form is available in person at the Namakkal District Health Office, or it can be downloaded from namakkal.nic.in.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the posts are wholly temporary, on contract basis, and that no post will be made permanent at any time.

faq.question: Q9. What is the qualification for Multi Purpose Worker?
faq.answer: The qualification printed is "Able to Read and Write". The age limit is 59 years as on 31.10.2026, the pay is Rs.11,000 per month, and the mode of appointment is shown as interview.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of proof of date of birth, educational qualification and marks, proof of residency and any other special records required by the selection criteria.
